result: Live 069 segments over the V3 composition cover all six AUTO/MANUAL/LEARNING transitions for taxis and civilians at the accepted tick, with mode, eligibility, position, route, class and profile. M/L are folded per tick with one PLAYER seat, position/speed/yaw continuity and AUTO resume from the current physical state. LEARNING exposes descriptors to 272 without publishing a profile; MANUAL produces no intake. The HUD has the mandated labels and the live LEARNING button is active.
limitations: G entry/exit remains the 195/196/198 path and does not create a separate 069 segment. AUTO resumes exactly on the first tick, but full lane re-projection and off-lane re-entry remain 054/282. The 069 lifecycle capacity is 64 segments per session. Telemetry 272, learning pipeline 273 and settings 279 remain separate. The browser probe is Chrome 157 / WEBGL2 without an FPS/GPU/hardware claim. Local Node is 24.19.0.
